reason: Brands already come to me in my DMs and I keep 100% of those, so I'm not going to set up yet another profile and give up 10% on a platform that admits it barely has any brands. If I signed up I'd probably just let it sit there.
objection: Another marketplace taking a cut of my money, and with so few brands on it I'd be paying $50 a deal for a site that might not get me a single deal.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing proof that creators my size are actually getting paid deals there, like a friend landing two or three paid bookings in their first month, not just free product.
